rows.label: Saffron
rows.description: spice derived from the flower of Crocus sativus
rows.hook: is the world's priciest spice by weight, hand-picked from a purple crocus

rows.label: Cinnamon
rows.description: spice obtained from the inner bark of several tree species from the genus Cinnamomum
rows.hook: is rolled into curled quills and sprinkled on buttery morning pastries

rows.label: Licorice
rows.hook: gives black candy its sweet, anise-like taste

rows.label: Cloves
rows.hook: is a dark, nail-shaped spice pressed into holiday hams and oranges

rows.label: Black pepper
rows.hook: is the most common seasoning shaken beside salt on dining tables

rows.label: Cardamom
rows.hook: is a fragrant pod spice stirred into chai and Scandinavian pastries

rows.label: Turmeric
rows.hook: gives curry its golden-yellow color

rows.label: Nutmeg
rows.description: spice from trees in the genus Myristica
rows.hook: is grated over eggnog and shares its tree with the spice mace

rows.label: Chili pepper
rows.description: fruit of plants from the genus Capsicum, members of the nightshade family, Solanaceae
rows.hook: packs fiery heat from capsaicin, measured on the Scoville scale

rows.label: Wasabi
rows.hook: is the pungent green paste served alongside sushi

rows.label: Rosemary
rows.description: species of plant, for the culinary or medicinal herb use Q68315046
rows.hook: is a piney-scented Mediterranean herb paired with roast lamb and potatoes

rows.label: Vanilla
rows.description: spice derived from the seed pods of the genus Vanilla
rows.hook: gives ice cream its classic flavor and comes from an orchid

rows.label: Ginger
rows.hook: is a zesty, knobby spice that is pickled for sushi and brewed into tea

rows.label: Sesame
rows.description: flowering plant cultivated for its edible seeds
rows.hook: tops hamburger buns and is ground into tahini

rows.label: Cumin
rows.hook: is the earthy spice that defines taco seasoning and chili powder

rows.label: Garlic
rows.description: species of plant (for the food, use Q21546392)
rows.hook: is the pungent kitchen staple folklore says repels vampires

rows.label: Allspice
rows.description: spice; for the species, use Q158468
rows.hook: is a Jamaican berry that tastes like a mix of cinnamon, nutmeg and cloves

rows.label: Basil
rows.hook: is the sweet herb blended into pesto and layered in caprese salad

rows.label: Chamomile
rows.description: common name, for several daisy-like plants

rows.label: Oregano
rows.hook: is the herb sprinkled on pizza and used throughout Greek cooking

rows.label: Marjoram
rows.hook: is a sweet, mild herb often called oregano's gentler relative

rows.label: Bay laurel
rows.hook: is the fragrant herb tossed whole into soups and stews, then fished out

rows.label: Parsley
rows.description: species of flowering plant in the celery family Apiaceae cultivated as an herb
rows.hook: is the curly green garnish found on many restaurant plates

rows.label: Thyme
rows.description: herb with culinary, medicinal and ornamental uses
rows.hook: is a woody herb bundled into the French bouquet garni

rows.label: Poppy
rows.hook: tops bagels and lemon muffins as tiny blue-gray specks

rows.label: Tarragon
rows.description: perennial herb with an aniseed scent
rows.hook: is the anise-flavored herb in classic bearnaise sauce

rows.label: Chives
rows.hook: is the mild onion-flavored herb snipped over baked potatoes

rows.label: Galangal
rows.description: rhizome of several plants from the ginger family (Zingiberaceae)
